summary: Build a simple, user-friendly social media app where anyone can sign up (with an automatic sign-up flow) and upload/browse content such as videos and posts.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Minimalist app logo mark, rounded shape, warm neutral tones (logo-mark.dim_512x512.png)
- Simple empty-state illustration of a phone/feed with abstract shapes, warm neutral palette (empty-feed-illustration.dim_1200x600.png)

existing_features.title: Implement Internet Identity authentication with an automatic sign-up flow: when a new principal first signs in, create a user profile automatically with sensible defaults (e.g., handle derived from principal, display name empty) and do not show a separate signup form.
Build a content creation UI that lets a signed-in user create a new post with caption text and optionally upload one media file (image or video) using a simple, guided form.

Build a user-friendly feed/browsing experience that displays posts from all users, including caption, author, timestamp, and inline rendering of attached media (images shown as images; videos playable with standard controls).
Add basic profile viewing/editing for the signed-in user: display principal-based identity, allow setting a display name and bio, and show a simple list/count of the user’s posts.

Apply a coherent, distinct visual theme and layout for a modern, user-friendly social app UI (consistent typography, spacing, and components). Use a warm neutral palette (avoid blue/purple) and keep the experience simple and accessible.

new_feature_requests.summary: User authentication with automatic sign-up flow
Content upload system for videos and posts (allow users to upload content)
Content feed/browsing UI for viewing uploaded posts and videos
Clean, user-friendly interface for posting and browsing content

Create backend data models and APIs to support a social media feed with user-generated content, including: user profile records, post records (text caption + timestamps + author), and optional attached media (image/video) stored on the canister within defined size limits.

projectName: User-friendly social media app with automatic sign-up and posts/videos feed
